mentions.name: threeemojis
mentions.description: A daily word game for learning foreign languages, currently playable in German with plans to add more languages. Puzzles are being refined by filtering out archaic and ancient words.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.threeemojis.com/ , a daily word game for learning foreign languages. It's been a lot of fun to work on, and it's almost something that I am very proud of. For now it's only playable in German, and someday I hope that it will include many more languages.
